h2: Water Leak Repair Uluwatu: Find & Fix Hidden Leaks
intro: If your PDAM meter keeps spinning or a pump won't shut off, you likely have a hidden leak somewhere in the villa. Water Leak Repair Uluwatu covers everything from a slow drip under the kitchen sink to a burst PPR pipe buried behind a bathroom wall. On the dry limestone Bukit, every litre lost is a litre you'll pay to replace by tank delivery.

sections.h3: Why Leaks Hit Harder on the Bukit
sections.text: Uluwatu sits on porous limestone, so mains pressure is inconsistent and many villas in Bingin and Pecatu depend entirely on storage tanks, deep wells, or scheduled deliveries. A small pinhole in a garden line can drain a large tank overnight. Salt spray off the cliff also corrodes copper fittings and shower valves faster than inland, turning a minor seep into a full replacement job within months. That combination means even a slow drip costs real money here.

sections.h3: The Leaks We Most Often Trace in Uluwatu
sections.text: Under-sink drips from corroded PPR joints are the most common call, especially in Ungasan where salt air eats through thread connections. Shower trays and floor drains that weep onto tile grout come next. Then there are the invisible ones: a burst pipe behind a bathroom wall, or an irrigation line splitting under the garden path, both of which announce themselves only when the pump runs non-stop or the meter creeps upward while every tap is closed.

sections.h3: What to Send on WhatsApp Before We Come Out
sections.text: A short video of the affected area helps enormously—under the sink, around the shower base, or the garden line in question. If you suspect a hidden leak, film your PDAM meter with all taps and appliances off for two minutes so we can see it moving. Include the villa's neighbourhood (Bingin, Padang Padang, Pecatu, etc.) and whether the issue started after a storm or has been building slowly. That context lets us bring the right fittings and tools the first time.

sections.h3: Prevention Tips Specific to Uluwatu's Conditions
sections.text: Because limestone water is hard, descale shower heads and heater elements every six months to avoid pressure build-up that cracks joints. Check float valves in your storage tank quarterly—a stuck valve overflows and wastes hundreds of litres. On cliff-top villas, wipe salt residue off exposed tapware and pool equipment with fresh water weekly. And if you hear a pump cycling on and off more than usual, get it looked at before the pressure switch fails completely.

faq.q: How do I know if my villa has a hidden leak?
faq.a: Turn everything off, then watch your PDAM meter for two to three minutes. If the dial still moves, or a pump keeps restarting with no demand, there's likely a leak in a wall, under a slab, or in the garden line.

faq.q: Do you handle both PVC and PPR pipe repairs?
faq.a: Yes—burst or cracked joints in either material fall within the scope of Water Leak Repair Uluwatu work. We carry common-diameter fittings on site and can source less-standard sizes when a job requires them.

faq.q: Will salt air make new fittings corrode again quickly?
faq.a: It does accelerate wear on exposed metal parts, particularly on cliff-top villas in Ungasan or Balangan. Choosing brass or stainless fittings where possible, plus regular fresh-water rinses, extends their life considerably compared to inland locations.
